Done. All contract checks pass locally.

**What I built**

- `scroll-memory.ts` — pure storage module: `scrollKey(hostId, absPath)` → `md-editor:scroll:<hostId>:<absPath>`; `saveScroll`/`loadScroll` over one localStorage map, all access try/catch'd (corrupt JSON or missing `localStorage` → `null`, never throws). `saveScroll` merges per-field so saving one scroller keeps the other's offset, re-inserts the key as most-recently-used, and evicts oldest beyond 200 entries.
- `app.tsx` — one effect keyed on `scrollMemKey = scrollKey(doc.hostId, doc.absPath)`: a capture-phase `scroll` listener on the opener root records `scrollTop` from `.mdpro-scroll` (rich) and `sourceHandle.view.scrollDOM` (the source editor's `.cm-scroller`, which also excludes the PropertiesPanel YAML editor), flushed to `saveScroll` throttled at 200 ms and on unmount cleanup. On first mount per file it restores the saved rich offset, retrying every 50 ms for up to 1 s until the scroller is tall enough (Mermaid/images grow after first paint); `wheel`/`touchmove`/`keydown`/`pointerdown` cancel the retry so the user wins. A second small effect applies the saved source offset when the source editor mounts. `experimental_lineRange` skips restore entirely, leaving the existing targeted-open scroll untouched. Scroll events never touch `body`/`baselineBody`, so opening stays clean.
- `scroll-memory.test.ts` — round-trip per key, cross-key null, partial-save merge, corrupt JSON + missing localStorage, 200-entry eviction.
- `scroll-restore.test.tsx` — JSDOM remount test proving scrollTop 640 survives unmount→remount, plus a targeted-open test proving the saved offset is not applied.
- `mobile.test.tsx` — unchanged; still passes.

Checks run here: `node --import tsx --test scroll-memory.test.ts` (4/4), `node --import tsx --test mobile.test.tsx` (3/3), `node --import tsx --test scroll-restore.test.tsx` (2/2), `npm run typecheck` (exit 0), `npm test` (55/55).

APPROACH: Store positions in one localStorage map with merge-on-save and LRU eviction; in app.tsx use a capture-phase scroll listener on the opener root (works regardless of when scrollers mount) plus a retrying restore that yields to user scroll gestures; key everything by `scrollKey(doc.hostId, doc.absPath)` and skip restore for targeted opens.
LESSON: `EditorView.scrollDOM` is the `.cm-scroller` element — using it avoids `querySelector('.cm-scroller')` matching the PropertiesPanel YAML editor; and accumulating positions in a ref during scroll events (rather than reading the DOM at cleanup) survives React's unmount ordering where the Tiptap editor is already destroyed.

dispatchContext.rulesText:
- In a folder without git (live-folder mode), never put a task's expected_outputs or owns_paths under .bb/ (chat folders): the live snapshot skips .bb, so a file written there is never counted as produced and the task blocks as missing expected_outputs. Put task deliverables in a project folder such as docs/ or reports/.
- Правя тестовый файл из owns_paths, меняй только ожидаемые значения внутри существующих строгих assert (deepEqual/equal) и добавляй новые проверки рядом — не удаляй строки assert и не ослабляй строгую проверку до assert.ok/includes/truthiness; перед ответом перечитай свой diff по тестам и верни всё, что стало слабее: test_fit помечает это как сломанную проверку, и попытки сгорают до лимита.
- In MyPosts, never let src/app or app.tsx import a value from src/shared/contract.ts (it imports the server SDK @get-bb/plugin-sdk, which the hub's frontend build cannot resolve); frontend values live in src/shared/model.ts, contract imports in the frontend are `import type` only. Before tagging a release, run the frontend-bundle test (or /tmp/mp-hubcheck/check.mjs) — the integration gate does not catch this.
